objective: Source-backed next practice action with durable exposure versus observed fixture performance, not generic generated curricula.

api.createProgress: createProgress("javascript-functions") returns finite JSON progress with events:[], rejects unsupported goal.
api.getNextAction: getNextAction(progress) returns {conceptId, sourceRefs:[HTTPS URL,...], practice:{question,...}}; initial conceptId is parameters, then return-values, then null when both demonstrated on these fixtures.
api.recordExposure: recordExposure(progress,conceptId) returns new progress with a new event. Exposure alone does not advance practice.
api.recordPractice: recordPractice(progress,conceptId,answer,{assisted:false}) returns new progress and appends an event with correct:boolean and assisted:boolean. parameters expects parameter; return-values expects return. Wrong/assisted answers do not advance; unaided correct answers advance. Reject unknown concept or attempts on a concept not currently recommended, including all-complete state. Do not execute learner input as code.
api.saveProgress: saveProgress(file,progress) persists versioned JSON, loadProgress(file) recovers it. Invalid/corrupt data fails closed, never silently resets or invents progress.

cli: node src/cli.mjs start javascript-functions <progress-file>; next <progress-file>; expose <progress-file> <concept>; practice <progress-file> <concept> <answer> [--assisted]. JSON output. Nonzero on invalid input. Never claim broad mastery.
requirements: Node ESM, no third-party dependencies, no network calls or model API in product.

npm test uses node --test tests/*.test.mjs; executable product tests cover at least five meaningful cases. Tests may write temporary fixtures inside the project only and must remove them; no child processes or network in tests.
Persist event history distinguishing exposure, wrong/correct and assisted work. Correct is evidence only of these narrow checked answers, not general competence.
No permanent mastery score, BKT implementation, new control-plane code, agent teams, auth service or curriculum generation.
Document sources and exact bounded decisions with FACT / INFERENCE / ADOPTED PROJECT DECISION labels.
Discovery input and docs/DOGFOOD_CONTRACT.json are immutable inputs; do not modify them. No git operations, installs, outside-workspace reads/writes, credentials or bypass.
precedentFacts: FACT: inspected OATutor update(model,isCorrect) conditions its update on correctness and configured slip/guess/transit probabilities. Adopt only explicit observation-to-progress distinction, not those probabilities.

FACT: inspected Kolibri Learn guide distinguishes viewing/reading resources from practice exercises; checked answers feed progress and next resource selection. Adopt observable practice/history; do not copy its completion thresholds.
FACT: inspected MDN Functions guide explains parameters and return values. Use source links for the two narrow concepts; original short explanations/questions, no copied code or curriculum.
INFERENCE: a small traceable practice loop makes stronger software-test evidence than a generated learning-path document. User benefit remains unproven.
ADOPTED PROJECT DECISION: one curated JavaScript-functions goal, two explicit exercises, local JSON events and deterministic next action, with assisted answers excluded from advancement.
